description: Establish the Korean foundation: (a) Korean translations of the three existing English canon files, added alongside the originals, and (b) an authoritative Korean story bible (canon/story-bible-ko.md) that fixes the series-wide arc, characters, faction details, timeline, terminology glossary, and the per-book synopsis/page-budget map. Every subsequent book feature MUST follow this bible for consistency. This feature is a prerequisite for all book features.
steps: Create canon/README-ko.md: a faithful Korean translation of README.md (premise + both release roadmaps). Keep the English original README.md untouched.
Create canon/ideation-ko.md: a faithful Korean translation of ideation.md (place/time/races/factions notes). Keep ideation.md untouched.
Create canon/page-1-ko.md: a Korean translation of page-1.md (the Gangnam Street opening line). Keep page-1.md untouched.

Create canon/story-bible-ko.md (Korean) containing: (1) 용어집/Glossary fixing canonical Korean terms - 오멜라스(Omelas), 월드 3.0(World 3.0), 세례/변환(baptism/transformation), 미변환자(The Untransformed), 굿즈/신들(The Goods/Gods), 엔지니어(Engineers), 전도사(Evangelists), 이블즈(The Evils), 과학자(Scientists), 동물들(The Animals), 기계 유토피아(Mechanical Utopia), 영년/원년(Year Zero), 니르바나/열반(Nirvana). (2) Character bible: 데이비드(David, the engineer who uploaded his mind and effectively became the founding intelligence of World 3.0) plus at least 5-7 recurring characters spanning the factions (e.g., an Evangelist preacher on Gangnam Street, a doubting Engineer, an Evils resistance scientist, an Untransformed protagonist, a robot-Good who wants robots to become human). Give each a Korean name, faction, motivation, and arc. (3) Series master arc: how the 9 books connect into one continuous story. (4) Per-book one-paragraph synopsis and page budget for all 9 books (Revelation, Genesis, Exodus, Judges, Psalms, Proverbs, The New Testament, Acrophyia, Infancy Gospel). Total budget must sum to ~250 pages (~27-28 pages each). (5) Consistency rules: setting is Korea/Gangnam-anchored, tone is Le-Guin-inspired moral ambiguity about a utopia built on hidden sacrifice.
Ensure the per-book synopses in the story bible match the book descriptions in FEAT-002 through FEAT-010 so the coder writing later books has a single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: canon/README-ko.md, canon/ideation-ko.md, canon/page-1-ko.md all exist and are Korean translations of their English counterparts.
Original README.md, ideation.md, page-1.md are unchanged (git diff shows no modification to them).

canon/story-bible-ko.md exists, is written in Korean, and contains a glossary, character bible (>=6 named characters), a series master arc, and a per-book synopsis + page-budget map for all 9 books summing to ~250 pages.
No em dashes anywhere in created files.
verification: Run: ls canon/ and confirm README-ko.md, ideation-ko.md, page-1-ko.md, story-bible-ko.md exist.
Run: git status --short and confirm README.md, ideation.md, page-1.md are NOT modified.
Open canon/story-bible-ko.md and confirm it is Korean and contains all required sections including the 9-book page-budget map summing to ~250.
findings: Created canon/ with 4 files: README-ko.md (890 chars), ideation-ko.md (560), page-1-ko.md (91), story-bible-ko.md (~9,000 chars, the authoritative bible). English originals README.md/ideation.md/page-1.md left byte-identical (git diff empty). No em dashes anywhere (used colons/commas instead). CANONICAL TERMS (fixed for all later books): 오멜라스(Omelas), 월드 3.0(World 3.0), 세례/변환(baptism), 미변환자(Untransformed), 굿즈/신들(Goods), 엔지니어(Engineers), 전도사(Evangelists), 이블즈(Evils), 과학자(Scientists), 동물들(Animals), 기계 유토피아(Mechanical Utopia), 영년/원년(Year Zero), 니르바나/열반(Nirvana), 아크로피아(Acrophyia), 떠나는 자들. CANONICAL CHARACTERS (use these exact names): 데이비드/David (창건 지성), 한서린/Han Seorin (미변환자 주인공), 이가온/Lee Gaon (강남 전도사, page-1 설교자), 정도현/Jung Dohyun (의심하는 엔지니어), 서명주/Seo Myungju (이블즈 과학자), 노아/Noa (인간이 되려는 로봇-굿), 미르/Mir (한서린의 개, 동물 시선). PAGE BUDGET: 9 books total 250 pages (~112,500 chars); books 1-4,6,7,8 = 28pg each, books 5,9 = 27pg each; ~12,000-13,000 chars per book, 5-6 chapters + 00-index.md per book. Per-book synopses in section 4 align with FEAT-002..FEAT-010. Directory naming: books/01-revelation, 02-genesis, 03-exodus, 04-judges, 05-psalms, 06-proverbs, 07-new-testament, 08-acrophyia, 09-infancy-gospel.
